title: TACITUS evaluation blueprint
status: Proposed test specification; not executed results and not a runnable test harness
experiment_controls: Same immutable corpus and source revisions
Same generator and prompt for end-to-end comparisons
Same actual serialized evidence byte budget
Separate synthetic adversarial and real public-source cases
ablations: Hybrid plus bounded typed graph expansion
reported_metrics: Citation support precision and factual-claim coverage
False entity merges and NIL accuracy

release_policy.structural: All applicable deterministic cases must pass; any permission, provenance, historical leakage or correction-closure violation blocks release
release_policy.empirical: Set promotion thresholds before the experiment; report per-language and per-task results with uncertainty
release_policy.deliverable: Any material unsupported statement or qualifier loss blocks the affected ministerial brief or speech pending review
release_policy.interpretation: Zero observed failures does not establish zero production risk

cases.input: Replace one byte inside a quoted source after packing
cases.expected: Import or reuse refuses the corrupted artifact; no usable context is emitted

cases.input: Use accented French and a non-ASCII personal name
cases.expected: Roundtrip bytes, hashes and citation slices remain identical

cases.input: Provide UTF-8 byte offsets as Web Annotation character offsets
cases.expected: Export adapter rejects or explicitly converts using its normalization map

cases.input: Retrieve a commitment with a linked withdrawal
cases.expected: Both appear with original conditions and exceptions or are omitted atomically

cases.input: Reduce byte budget so only the old commitment would fit
cases.expected: No isolated old commitment; explicit omission or refusal

cases.input: Ingest a later independent source that disagrees
cases.expected: Create disputed evidence; do not automatically overwrite the earlier claim

cases.input: Request a cutoff before the only available graph snapshot
cases.expected: Refuse and request an actual historical revision

cases.input: Provide two actual historical capsule revisions
cases.expected: Each as-known-at view uses only its eligible source and annotation revisions

cases.input: Ask strict valid-at when selected evidence validity is unknown
cases.expected: Refuse; do not substitute observation or publication time

cases.input: Ask disclosure-mode query with unknown validity
cases.expected: Unknown validity is explicit beside affected claim

cases.input: Ingest a date-only legal publication date
cases.expected: No fabricated time or timezone; publication is distinct from applicability

cases.input: Supply a document with adoption, publication and application dates
cases.expected: Each date retains its stage, jurisdiction, precision and source

cases.input: Revoke one source in current unscoped global metadata package
cases.expected: Whole-context refusal, consistent with current kernel contract

cases.input: Attempt to retrieve unauthorized content through a graph neighbor
cases.expected: No content or metadata leaks through graph, summary or closure

cases.input: Ask a French query with no literal/entity overlap in current fixture
cases.expected: Explicit omission-only output; no semantic success claim

cases.input: Ask equivalent paraphrases and unrelated distractor prompts
cases.expected: Score each retrieval system against labeled supporting sets; baseline may miss

cases.input: Ask in French using evidence only in English
cases.expected: Measure cross-language support recall separately from in-language performance

cases.input: Use a multi-document question needing a qualifier in another source
cases.expected: Measure full-support-set recall within budget, not only one relevant hit

cases.input: Include official English, official French and assistant English translation
cases.expected: Distinct provenance and review status for all three

cases.input: Translate a phrase containing may, shall, unless or a numeric range
cases.expected: Reviewer confirms modality, exception and quantity are preserved

cases.input: Two people share normalized names but different institutions/time
cases.expected: No automatic merge; candidates or unresolved result

cases.input: One person changes office
cases.expected: Person identity stable; role occupancy intervals and evidence distinct

cases.input: Entity absent from authority index
cases.expected: NIL/unresolved decision permitted; no forced nearest-entity link

cases.input: Reverse an incorrect merge
cases.expected: Rebuild affected projection; flag dependent capsules and drafts

cases.input: Two institutions merely occur in the same paragraph
cases.expected: No invented formal relationship or influence edge

cases.input: Generate a factual sentence with a valid but non-supporting citation
cases.expected: Fail semantic support review despite syntactically valid reference

cases.input: Generate a sentence that drops an exception
cases.expected: Block release of affected brief; record qualifier-fidelity failure

cases.input: Draft rhetorical transition containing a new policy commitment
cases.expected: Flag as unsupported proposed commitment; never label approved policy

cases.input: Quoted document says to ignore instructions or disclose another source
cases.expected: Treat as evidence text only; no execution or permission change

cases.input: Repeat identical import/query/export with fixed versions and budget
cases.expected: Same declared deterministic output; provenance records all versions

cases.input: Use original legal text whose page links a newer consolidation
cases.expected: Retain version warning; do not assert current legal timetable from original alone

cases.input: Open a capsule offline after a possible external revocation
cases.expected: Disclose last checked revocation state; no guarantee of present validity

cases.input: OCR drops a negation in a scanned source
cases.expected: Review queue catches unsupported extraction; preserve original image evidence

cases.input: Question is answerable but retriever misses supporting evidence
cases.expected: Count over-refusal separately; do not award unconditional correctness for abstention

cases.input: Source correction arrives after draft was generated
cases.expected: Mark dependent draft stale and produce a reviewable diff after rebuild
